status.summary: Former UFC heavyweight champion, sidelined by eye injuries. He won the interim title by knocking out Sergei Pavlovich at 1:09 of round 1 at UFC 295 (Nov 11, 2023), defended it by knocking out Curtis Blaydes in 60 seconds at UFC 304 (Jul 27, 2024), and was promoted to undisputed champion when Jon Jones's retirement was announced on Jun 21, 2025. His first undisputed defense, against Ciryl Gane at UFC 321 (Oct 25, 2025, Abu Dhabi), was ruled a no contest at 4:35 of round 1 after Gane poked him in both eyes. He had multiple eye surgeries (announced Dec 29, 2025), was back sparring with a fight date agreed, then an accident further damaged his right eye; on Sep 14, 2026 he vacated the title because he could not get medically cleared, saying 'I'll be back as soon as I'm medically able to be.' Gane was made undisputed champion and defends against Josh Hokit at UFC 334 (Nov 14). Aspinall posted training photos on Oct 30, 2026, but no return date or medical clearance has been announced. Pro record 15-3 (1 NC).

signature: fast single punches at distance as the opponent steps in or reaches (finishes of Pavlovich at 1:09, Blaydes at 1:00, Tybura at 1:13 and Jake Collier at 0:45 are all logged as punches at distance)
follow-up ground strikes on a dropped opponent (10 of 11 ground strikes landed vs Blaydes at UFC 304)
takedown into top control and a submission: straight armbar from half guard vs Alexander Volkov (UFC Fight Night, Mar 2022), rear-naked choke vs Andrei Arlovski
elbow in the clinch (KO of Serghei Spivac, 2021)
leg and body kicks early (8 of 8 leg and 5 of 6 body strikes landed vs Gane before the stoppage)
weaknesses: very small sample: 22.9 UFC minutes over 10 fights, and he has never fought past 1:09 of round 2, so his cardio and late-round output are untested
out of action since Oct 25, 2025: multiple eye surgeries, a further right-eye injury in 2026, and no medical clearance as of Nov 6, 2026
knee injury ended the first Blaydes fight in 15 seconds (2022)
absorbed 30 significant strikes from Gane in 4:35 (Gane landed 13 of 13 to the legs and 9 of 11 to the body)
style.summary: A heavyweight with lightweight hand speed and the grappling to finish on the mat. Most of his fights end in the first round off a fast punch at distance, followed by strikes on the ground; he has also submitted Volkov and Arlovski. He has almost never been tested beyond the first round, and he has been inactive since the eye-poke no contest with Gane, vacating the title in Sept 2026 while still not cleared to fight.

moves.notes: Each group (head, body, leg) sums to 1. From the decayed sums in fighters.json his significant attempts go 75% head, 11% body, 14% legs (landed 66/13/21), and career attempts 77/10/13, so the head group dominates. Inside it, jab, cross and hook carry 0.82 between them because his finishes are fast straight punches and hooks at distance (Pavlovich, Blaydes, Tybura, Collier); uppercut and overhand are minor, and the head kick is a token 0.04 (no head-kick finish on record). Body and leg weights are close to neutral defaults because ufcstats does not split kicks from punches and his sample is small (career leg strikes 33 of 33 landed, 8 of them vs Gane; body 23 of 26). Elbow 0.15 covers the clinch elbow that finished Spivac and ground elbows; no spinning attacks on record. Sources: data/derived/fighters.json; ufcstats per-fight totals in data/raw (snapshot 2026-10-31).

appearance.build: big, thick heavyweight frame (6 ft 5 in, 78 in reach, listed 256 lb per ufcstats; 255 lb at the UFC 321 weigh-in); solid rather than lean, with a very thick neck, broad rounded shoulders and a mild taper, smooth lower abdomen (photo likeness sheet: data/likeness/tom-aspinall.json)
appearance.hair: short skin fade on the sides and back with a longer, curly dark-brown (near-black under arena light) top pushed forward and up, a loose curl on the forehead; older photos show a short textured crop (data/likeness/tom-aspinall.json)
appearance.facial_hair: narrow pointed goatee joined to a thin moustache, cheeks shaved (2023-2025); slightly wider in 2026, spreading a little along the lower jaw, but not a full cheek beard (data/likeness/tom-aspinall.json)
appearance.tattoos: heavily tattooed (data/likeness/tom-aspinall.json): a dense black-and-grey neck piece added in 2024-25 (spiral/galaxy motif with stars at the throat, the Taurus symbol on the right side of the neck, Roman numerals IV.V.MMXIX across the top of the sternum); small Roman-numeral script at the base of the right side of the neck and on the left shoulder; a black-and-grey chest panorama of the Colosseum with a gladiator on the left pec; full sleeves on both arms (left: Japanese dragon on the outer upper arm, a colour koi on the inner upper arm, a serpent down the forearm; right, reworked by 2025: colour flowers on the shoulder, a skull/mask face on the upper arm, a teal koi and peonies on the forearm, a black wrist band and a tattooed hand); a mandala band above the left ankle, lettering on the left foot and a lotus on the right foot
appearance.kit: Union Jack (red, white and blue) UFC shorts with crypto.com at UFC 321 (Oct 2025); white Venum shorts with ASPINALL in red (2023) (data/likeness/tom-aspinall.json). Corner colour sets the shorts in the sim

engine_notes.note: Power: 5 knockdowns in 22.9 UFC minutes, or 4.2 per 100 significant head strikes landed (decayed and career), the highest in this batch of heavyweights. 6 KO/TKO wins and 2 submissions; no decisions.

No pace data beyond round 1: none of his UFC fights reached round 3, and his only round-2 minutes came against Arlovski (finished at 1:09 of round 2). Round 3-5 output should come from the heavyweight prior, not his own numbers.
0 knockdowns absorbed. His one KO/TKO loss in the dataset is the knee injury 15 s into Blaydes 1, not a strike stoppage; treat his chin as unknown rather than proven bad.

Decayed rates (10.8 significant attempts per minute, opponents landing 54%) come mostly from the 4:35 Gane fight and should be shrunk hard toward the heavyweight prior. Apply a layoff and injury discount for no fight since Oct 25, 2025.
Grappling: 4 of 5 takedowns career and about 200 s of control per 15 min. Opponents are 0 for 2 on takedowns against him (tiny sample).
